1-1.title: Cybersecurity Strategy
1-1.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity plans, goals, initiatives and projects are contributing to compliance with related laws and regulations.
cybersecurity_tools: All cybersecurity strategy models and roadmap
1-1.full_text: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy: Objective is to ensure that cybersecurity plans, goals, initiatives and projects are contributing to compliance with related laws and regulations.

1-1-1.title: Strategy Definition and Approval
1-1-1.objective: A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, documented and approved by the Authorizing Official.
implementation_guidelines: Conduct a workshop with stakeholders to align cybersecurity objectives with the organization's strategic objectives.
Develop and document the strategy to align with related laws and regulations (e.g., CCC, CSCC).
Include Vision, Mission, Strategic Objectives, Implementation Plan, Projects, and Initiatives.
expected_deliverables: Approved Cybersecurity Strategy Document
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity strategy models and roadmap
1-1-1.full_text: 1-1-1 A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, documented and approved. The strategy goals must be in-line with related laws and regulations.

1-1-2.title: Cybersecurity Roadmap Execution
1-1-2.objective: A roadmap must be executed to implement the cybersecurity strategy.
implementation_guidelines: Define cybersecurity priorities.
Monitor the implementation of strategy projects and initiatives and take corrective steps.
Ensure implementation of projects according to requirements.
Provide a clear unified vision and communicate it to stakeholders.
Obtain NCA's approval for initiatives beyond the standard scope.
expected_deliverables: Cybersecurity Roadmap Document
Performance measurement reports
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity performance report and measurement template
1-1-2.full_text: 1-1-2 A roadmap must be executed to implement the cybersecurity strategy.

1-1-3.title: Periodic Strategy Review
1-1-3.objective: The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed periodically or upon changes to laws.
implementation_guidelines: Review and update the strategy according to a documented and approved review plan.
expected_deliverables: Strategy review record/report
1-1-3.full_text: 1-1-3 The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to related laws.

1-2.title: Cybersecurity Management
1-2.objective: To establish and manage cybersecurity programs within the organization as per related laws and regulations.
1-2.full_text: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management: Objective is to manage cybersecurity programs within the organization.

1-2-1.title: Dedicated Cybersecurity Function
1-2-1.objective: A dedicated and independent cybersecurity function must be established.
implementation_guidelines: The function must be independent from the Information Technology (IT/ICT) functions.
1-2-1.full_text: 1-2-1 A dedicated cybersecurity function (e.g., division, department) must be established within the organization.

1-2-2.title: Cybersecurity Leadership
1-2-2.objective: Fill critical cybersecurity positions with experienced Saudi professionals.
1-2-2.full_text: 1-2-2 The position of head of cybersecurity (CISO) and critical positions must be filled with full-time and experienced Saudi professionals.

1-2-3.title: Cybersecurity Steering Committee
1-2-3.objective: Establish a committee to ensure support and implementation of cybersecurity programs.
1-2-3.full_text: 1-2-3 A cybersecurity steering committee must be established by the Authorizing Official.

1-3.title: Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
1-3.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are documented, communicated and complied with.

1-3-1.title: Policy Definition and Dissemination
1-3-1.objective: Define and disseminate approved cybersecurity policies and procedures.
1-3-1.full_text: 1-3-1 Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be defined, approved, and disseminated to relevant parties.

1-4.title: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
1-4.objective: To ensure that roles and responsibilities are defined for all parties.

1-5.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management
1-5.objective: To ensure managing cybersecurity risks in a methodological approach.

1-5-1.title: Risk Management Methodology
1-5-1.objective: Define and approve risk management methodology based on CIA triad.
1-5-1.full_text: 1-5-1 Cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be defined, documented and approved.

1-5-3-1.title: Early Stage Risk Assessment
1-5-3-1.objective: Conduct risk assessments at the early stages of technology projects.
implementation_guidelines: Implement risk assessment procedures at early stages to avoid events that could compromise confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
1-5-3-1.full_text: 1-5-3-1 Early stages of technology projects risk assessment.

1-5-3-2.title: Major Changes Risk Assessment
1-5-3-2.objective: Conduct risk assessment before making major infrastructure changes.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements within the IT Change Management lifecycle.
Implement risk assessment before material changes in technology architecture.
1-5-3-2.full_text: 1-5-3-2 Before making major changes to technology infrastructure.

1-5-3-3.title: Third-Party Risk Assessment
1-5-3-3.objective: Conduct risk assessment when obtaining third-party services.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements within procurement and contract procedures.
Implement risk assessment when planning to acquire services from a third party.
expected_deliverables: A report outlining identification of cybersecurity risks for third-party services.
1-5-3-3.full_text: 1-5-3-3 During the planning phase of obtaining third party services.

1-5-3-4.title: New Services Pre-live Assessment
1-5-3-4.objective: Conduct risk assessment before going live with new technology services.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements within Release Management procedures.
Implement risk assessment at the planning stage and before the release of new products.
1-5-3-4.full_text: 1-5-3-4 During the planning phase and before going live for new technology services.

1-6.title: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
1-6.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are included in project management methodology and procedures in order to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets as per organization policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.
1-6.full_text: 1-6 Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management: Objective is to ensure that cybersecurity requirements are included in project management methodology and procedures in order to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets as per organization policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

1-6-1.title: Inclusion of Cybersecurity Requirements in Project Management
1-6-1.objective: Cybersecurity requirements must be included in project and asset change management methodology and procedures to identify and manage cybersecurity risks.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements in the project management methodology and procedures.
Assess and detect vulnerabilities before deployment or upon any change.
Fix identified vulnerabilities before launching projects and changes.
Review Secure Configuration, Hardening, and Patching before launching.
Define requirements for connection with cyber surveillance systems.
Support requirements through Executive Management approval.
expected_deliverables: Project Management Methodology Document
Change management methodology or procedures document
cybersecurity_tools: Secure Software Development Cycle Policy Template
Secure Software Development Cycle Procedure Template
1-6-1.full_text: 1-6-1 Cybersecurity requirements must be included in project and asset (information/ technology) change management methodology and procedures. Guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements in methodology; Assess and detect vulnerabilities before deployment; Fix vulnerabilities before launching; Review Secure Configuration, Hardening and Patching; Define connection requirements for surveillance systems; Executive approval required.

1-6-2-1.title: Vulnerability assessment and remediation
1-6-2-1.objective: To identify and effectively address cybersecurity vulnerabilities throughout the technical project lifecycle.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this control in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Define systems, services, and technology components subject to Vulnerabilities Assessment.
Develop and adopt procedures for the implementation of Vulnerabilities Assessment and remediation.
Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before launching technical projects in the production environment.
Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before the implementation of changes to the production environment.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document for vulnerability assessment.
Report outlining assessment and remediation of vulnerabilities throughout the project lifecycle.
1-6-2-1.full_text: 1-6-2-1 Vulnerability assessment and remediation: Guidelines: Define and document requirements; Identify systems and components for assessment; Adopt procedures for assessment and remediation; Conduct assessment before launching projects and before implementing changes in production. Deliverables: Approved policy/procedure document, and assessment/remediation report.

1-6-2-2.title: Configurations review, secure configuration and hardening
1-6-2-2.objective: To ensure systems and services are securely configured and patched before going live.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Define systems, services, and technology components subject to Secure Configuration and Hardening review.
Provide technical Security Standard controls for systems and components.
Develop and adopt procedures for Secure Configuration and Hardening review.
Review secure Configuration, Hardening, and Patching before launching projects.
Review secure Configuration, Hardening, and Patching before implementing changes.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Technical Security Standard controls documents.
Report outlining the assessment and review of Secure Configuration and Hardening.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Project Management and Changes
Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development
1-6-2-2.full_text: 1-6-2-2 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live. Guidelines: Define systems for review; Provide technical standard controls; Adopt review procedures; Review hardening and patching before launching projects and before implementing changes. Deliverables: Approved document, technical standards, and review report.

1-6-3-1.title: Using secure coding standards
1-6-3-1.objective: To minimize cyber risks by focusing on confidentiality, integrity, and availability during development.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document technical cybersecurity requirements for Secure Coding Standard controls.
Cover all phases of the secure coding process based on laws, regulations, and best practices.
Communicate Secure Coding Standard controls to relevant departments (e.g., IT).
Ensure periodic implementation of secure coding standards.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Secure Coding Standard controls approved by the organization.
Documents confirming implementation of controls to assets.
cybersecurity_tools: Secure Coding Standard Template
1-6-3-1.full_text: 1-6-3-1 Using secure coding standards: Guidelines: Define technical requirements covering all phases; Align with laws and best practices; Communicate standards to IT; Ensure periodic implementation. Deliverables: Approved requirements document, Secure Coding Standard controls, and implementation evidence.

1-6-3-2.title: Using trusted and licensed sources
1-6-3-2.objective: To ensure that software development tools and libraries are obtained from reliable sources.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Use only modern, reliable and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Updated list of licensed and documented software for tools and libraries.
1-6-3-2.full_text: 1-6-3-2 Using trusted and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries: Guidelines: Define requirements; Use only modern, reliable, and licensed sources. Deliverables: Documented requirements, and an updated list of licensed software/libraries.

1-6-3-3.title: Conducting compliance test for software
1-6-3-3.objective: To verify that applications meet organizational cybersecurity requirements through testing.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Conduct testing (e.g., penetration testing) to verify compliance.
Ensure secure coding standards are applied and detect weaknesses/vulnerabilities.
Review cybersecurity architecture and access management requirements.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
List of application development projects and list of security tests performed.
Implementation reports showing the extent to which applications meet requirements.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development
1-6-3-3.full_text: 1-6-3-3 Conducting compliance test for software: Guidelines: Perform penetration testing; Verify application of secure coding; Detect weaknesses; Review architecture and access management. Deliverables: Documented requirements, list of tests performed, and implementation reports.

1-6-3-4.title: Secure integration between software components
1-6-3-4.objective: To ensure the security of data exchange and integration between different applications.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Ensure security of integration through testing (e.g., SIT, API testing).
Perform System Integration Testing (SIT).
Perform API testing.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Report outlining testing and assessment of secure integration between applications.
1-6-3-4.full_text: 1-6-3-4 Secure integration between software components: Guidelines: Define requirements; Perform System Integration Testing (SIT); Perform API testing to ensure secure exchange. Deliverables: Documented requirements, and integration assessment report.

1-6-3-5.title: Configurations review and hardening for software products
1-6-3-5.objective: To ensure software products are securely configured and patched before deployment and periodically thereafter.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Review secure Configuration, Hardening, and Patching before launching applications.
Review configurations periodically for existing applications.
Approve and safely store the Image for secure configuration.
Provide technology for centralized management and automated updates of configurations.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Reports or evidence of configuration/patching review before launching.
Reports or evidence of periodic configuration/patching reviews.
1-6-3-5.full_text: 1-6-3-5 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products: Guidelines: Review hardening before launching; Periodically review existing apps; Approve and secure 'Image'; Use central management for automated updates. Deliverables: Documented requirements, and evidence of pre-launch and periodic reviews.

1-6-4.title: Periodic Review of Project Management Requirements
1-6-4.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements in project management are reviewed and updated periodically.
implementation_guidelines: Review project management requirements periodically (e.g., annually) according to an approved plan.
Document the review and any changes to the requirements.
Obtain approval for changes from the head of the organization or deputy.
expected_deliverables: Approved document defining the review schedule.
Evidence that the periodic review and updates have been performed.
1-6-4.full_text: 1-6-4 The cybersecurity requirements in project management must be reviewed periodically. Guidelines: Conduct periodic review based on plan; Document and approve changes. Deliverables: Review schedule, and evidence of periodic review completion.

1-7.title: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standard controls, Laws and Regulations
1-7.objective: To ensure that the organization's cybersecurity practices are in compliance with related national and international laws and regulations.
1-7.full_text: 1-7 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standard controls, Laws and Regulations: Objective is to ensure compliance with laws and regulations. Includes identifying national laws, international agreements, and ensuring adherence through periodic updates and reporting.

1-7-1.title: Compliance with National Cybersecurity Laws and Regulations
1-7-1.objective: The organization must comply with related national cybersecurity laws and regulations issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA).
implementation_guidelines: Identify, document, and periodically update a list of national cybersecurity laws and regulations (e.g., Royal decrees, Council of Ministers orders, NCA circulars).
Work with stakeholders like the legal function and governance/compliance function.
Ensure compliance with all identified national requirements.
Provide necessary technologies to verify compliance.
Prepare compliance reports to be submitted to the NCA whenever requested.
expected_deliverables: Approved document (policy/procedure) for identifying national requirements.
Updated list of national cybersecurity laws and regulations applicable to the organization.
Compliance report outlining the extent of adherence to national laws.
cybersecurity_tools: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standard controls, Laws and Regulations Policy Template
1-7-1.full_text: 1-7-1 Compliance with National Cybersecurity Laws and Regulations: Guidelines: Identify and update list of NCA regulations (decrees, circulars); Collaborate with legal/compliance functions; Provide tools to verify compliance; Prepare reports for NCA. Deliverables: Approved identification policy, updated list of national laws, and compliance assessment report.

1-7-2.title: Compliance with International Agreements and Commitments
1-7-2.objective: The organization must comply with any nationally-approved international agreements and commitments related to cybersecurity.
implementation_guidelines: Work with stakeholders to identify, document, and approve the list of international cybersecurity agreements.
Ensure the list is subject to prior approval by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA).
Ensure compliance with all requirements approved by the NCA within the organization.
Provide necessary technologies to verify compliance with these international laws and regulations.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure for identifying international requirements.
Updated list of locally approved international agreements and obligations.
Report outlining the extent of compliance with international agreements.
1-7-2.full_text: 1-7-2 Compliance with any nationally-approved international agreements and commitments: Guidelines: Identify and document international agreements with NCA approval; Ensure adherence to NCA-approved requirements; Use technology to verify compliance. Deliverables: Approved identification document, list of international obligations, and compliance report.

1-8.title: Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit
1-8.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity controls are implemented and in compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and national/international laws and regulations.
1-8.full_text: 1-8 Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit: Objective is to ensure compliance and effective implementation of controls through periodic internal reviews and independent audits as per national and international requirements.

1-8-1.title: Internal Cybersecurity Reviews
1-8-1.objective: Cybersecurity reviews must be conducted periodically by the cybersecurity function to assess compliance with cybersecurity controls.
implementation_guidelines: Review the implementation of cybersecurity requirements periodically (e.g., quarterly) based on an approved plan.
Ensure controls are effectively implemented and operate in accordance with regulatory policies and national laws.
Verify implementation across information, technology, and physical assets.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure for identifying review requirements.
Approved plan to review the implementation of cybersecurity controls.
Periodic review reports of cybersecurity controls implementation.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review and Audit Template
Cybersecurity Review and Audit Log Template
1-8-1.full_text: 1-8-1 Internal Cybersecurity Reviews: Guidelines: Cybersecurity function must conduct periodic reviews (e.g., quarterly); Follow an approved plan; Ensure compliance with policies and national laws. Deliverables: Approved review plan, identification policy, and periodic review reports.

1-8-2.title: Independent Cybersecurity Audits
1-8-2.objective: Cybersecurity audits and reviews must be conducted by independent parties (e.g., Internal Audit or third parties) to ensure objectivity and no conflict of interest.
implementation_guidelines: Ensure the auditing party is independent of the cybersecurity function.
Follow Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS) and related laws.
Perform the audit periodically (e.g., annually) according to an approved plan.
Assess effective implementation against NCA-approved laws and organizational procedures.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure for independent audit requirements.
Approved plan to review and audit control implementation.
Audit reports issued by internal audit or independent external auditors.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review and Audit Template
Cybersecurity Review and Audit Log Template
1-8-2.full_text: 1-8-2 Independent Cybersecurity Audits: Guidelines: Use independent parties (Internal Audit/Third Party); Avoid conflict of interest; Follow GAAS; Conduct periodic audits (e.g., annually) against NCA laws. Deliverables: Approved audit plan, and independent audit reports.

1-8-3.title: Reporting and Remediation of Audit Results
1-8-3.objective: Audit results must be documented and presented to senior management and the steering committee to ensure corrective actions are taken.
implementation_guidelines: Document results including: Scope, observations, recommendations, and remediation plans.
Share and discuss results with the cybersecurity steering committee and the Authorizing Official (representative).
Develop and follow up on corrective actions for discovered observations.
expected_deliverables: Audit reports including scope, observations, and recommendations.
Evidence (e.g., meeting minutes) that results were presented to the steering committee.
Remediation plans for addressing audit findings.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review Report Template
1-8-3.full_text: 1-8-3 Reporting and Remediation of Audit Results: Guidelines: Report must include scope, observations, and remediation plans; Present results to the steering committee and Authorizing Official. Deliverables: Comprehensive audit reports, evidence of presentation to management, and documented remediation plans.

1-9.title: Cybersecurity in Human Resources
1-9.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity risks and requirements related to personnel (employees and contractors) are managed efficiently prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation.
1-9.full_text: 1-9 Cybersecurity in Human Resources: Objective is to efficiently manage personnel-related risks throughout their lifecycle (prior, during, and after employment) in compliance with policies and laws.

1-9-1.title: Definition of Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements
1-9-1.objective: To define, document, and approve cybersecurity requirements for personnel throughout their lifecycle.
implementation_guidelines: Define requirements for all stages: prior to recruitment, during work, and upon termination.
Include cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses in employment contracts.
Conduct screening/vetting for personnel in cybersecurity, technical, or critical functions.
Obtain approval from the head of the organization or deputy.
expected_deliverables: Approved Human Resources Cybersecurity Policy.
cybersecurity_tools: Human Resources Cybersecurity Policy Template
1-9-1.full_text: 1-9-1 Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be defined, documented and approved. Guidelines: Cover all lifecycle stages; Include NDAs and responsibilities in contracts; Screen personnel in critical functions; Obtain executive approval. Deliverables: Approved HR Cybersecurity Policy.

1-9-2.title: Implementation of Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements
1-9-2.objective: To ensure all defined personnel cybersecurity requirements are effectively implemented.
implementation_guidelines: Implement all requirements identified in the HR Cybersecurity Policy.
Develop an action plan for implementation.
Incorporate cybersecurity requirements into standard HR procedures.
expected_deliverables: Evidence of implementation of requirements.
Signed contract forms for cybersecurity personnel.
Screening or vetting requests for privileged access personnel.
1-9-2.full_text: 1-9-2 Implementation of personnel cybersecurity requirements: Guidelines: Implement all policy requirements; Develop an action plan; Embed requirements into HR procedures. Deliverables: Evidence of implementation, signed contracts, and screening requests.

1-9-3-1.title: Cybersecurity Clauses in Employment Contracts
1-9-3-1.objective: To ensure personnel are legally bound to cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure obligations.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
Include non-disclosure clauses covering periods during and after the job relationship.
Embed these requirements into HR procedures to ensure compliance for all stakeholders.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Signed organization personnel contract forms.
Signed cybersecurity function personnel contract forms.
cybersecurity_tools: Acknowledgment and confidentiality templates
1-9-3-1.full_text: 1-9-3-1 Inclusion of personnel cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses in employment contracts: Guidelines: Document requirements; Include clauses for during and after employment; Integrate into HR procedures. Deliverables: Approved policy, and signed personnel contract forms.

1-9-3-2.title: Screening or Vetting Candidates
1-9-3-2.objective: To verify the suitability of candidates for cybersecurity and critical or privileged positions.
implementation_guidelines: Screen or vet all employees in cybersecurity functions.
Screen or vet all technical personnel with privileged access (e.g., DBAs, firewall admins, system admins).
Formalize these requirements within HR procedures.
Obtain official documentation from relevant authorities as evidence of vetting.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Official evidence/documents from relevant authorities indicating screening or vetting was performed.
1-9-3-2.full_text: 1-9-3-2 Screening or vetting candidates of cybersecurity and critical/privileged positions: Guidelines: Vet all cybersecurity staff; Vet technical staff with privileged access (DBAs, admins); Document via HR procedures. Deliverables: Approved policy, and official vetting evidence from authorities.

1-9-4-1.title: Cybersecurity Awareness for New and Current Personnel
1-9-4-1.objective: To ensure personnel receive cybersecurity awareness at the start and throughout their employment.
implementation_guidelines: Provide awareness content during on-boarding and periodically thereafter.
Use approved communication channels (emails, workshops, etc.).
Review and document awareness plans and message content.
Include requirements in HR procedures.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Records of awareness provision (emails, workshop content, attendance).
Approved cybersecurity awareness plan.
1-9-4-1.full_text: 1-9-4-1 Cybersecurity awareness (during on-boarding and during employment): Guidelines: Provide awareness through approved channels; Review content and plans; Support with executive approval. Deliverables: Approved policy, awareness records (emails/workshops), and awareness plan.

1-9-4-2.title: Compliance with Cybersecurity Policies
1-9-4-2.objective: To ensure personnel acknowledge and adhere to the organization's cybersecurity policies and procedures.
implementation_guidelines: Inform all employees of policies and obtain their formal approval/acknowledgment.
Educate employees on their specific roles in implementing cybersecurity.
Embed these acknowledgment requirements into HR procedures.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Signed acknowledgment forms for cybersecurity policies from employees.
1-9-4-2.full_text: 1-9-4-2 Implementation of and compliance with the cybersecurity requirements: Guidelines: Obtain employee approval/acknowledgment on policies; Educate on roles; Integrate into HR procedures. Deliverables: Approved policy document, and signed acknowledgment forms.

1-9-5.title: Access Revocation and Asset Return upon Termination
1-9-5.objective: To ensure access is revoked and assets are returned immediately when personnel leave.
implementation_guidelines: Define professional end-of-service/termination procedures covering cybersecurity.
Revoke all access rights (physical and logical) immediately upon termination.
Ensure the return of all organization-owned assets.
expected_deliverables: Signed and approved discharge/clearance form for procedures implementation.
1-9-5.full_text: 1-9-5 Personnel access to assets must be reviewed and removed immediately upon termination/separation. Guidelines: Define termination procedures; Revoke access immediately; Ensure asset return. Deliverables: Signed discharge/clearance form.

1-9-6.title: Periodic Review of HR Cybersecurity Requirements
1-9-6.objective: To ensure personnel cybersecurity requirements remain up-to-date and effective.
implementation_guidelines: Review and update HR cybersecurity policies periodically (e.g., annually) or upon legal changes.
Document all reviews and changes.
Obtain formal approval from the head of the organization or deputy.
expected_deliverables: Approved review schedule for the policy.
Updated policy indicating review completion and executive approval.
1-9-6.full_text: 1-9-6 Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically. Guidelines: Conduct annual reviews or upon legal changes; Document changes; Obtain executive approval. Deliverables: Review schedule, and updated/approved policy.

1-10.title: Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program
1-10.objective: To ensure personnel are aware of their cybersecurity responsibilities and have essential awareness, training, skills, and credentials to protect the organization's assets.
1-10.full_text: 1-10 Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program: Objective is to build a positive security culture and ensure all personnel have the skills to protect assets. Includes development, implementation, and periodic review of awareness programs and specialized training.

1-10-1.title: Development of Cybersecurity Awareness Program
1-10-1.objective: To develop and approve a comprehensive awareness program conducted through multiple channels periodically.
implementation_guidelines: Develop and approve a program and plan using channels like emails, workshops, publications, billboards, and training platforms.
Coordinate with HR, Media, and Internal Communications to build a positive security culture.
Obtain formal approval from the Authorizing Official (representative).
expected_deliverables: Approved awareness program document.
cybersecurity_tools: Awareness program template
Awareness content template for all employees
Awareness content form for supervisory and executive positions
Information and Technology Assets Operators Awareness Content Form
1-10-1.full_text: 1-10-1 A cybersecurity awareness program must be developed and approved. Guidelines: Use multiple channels (emails, workshops, platforms); Coordinate with HR/Media; Build culture; Obtain executive approval. Deliverables: Approved awareness program document.

1-10-2.title: Implementation of Awareness Program
1-10-2.objective: To ensure the approved awareness and training program is effectively executed and evaluated.
implementation_guidelines: Implement the program in coordination with the training department.
Send awareness emails and conduct workshops.
Evaluate personnel awareness levels to identify and address weaknesses.
expected_deliverables: Action plan for program implementation.
Copies of awareness programs shared with employees.
List of beneficiaries/attendees.
1-10-2.full_text: 1-10-2 The cybersecurity awareness program must be implemented. Guidelines: Coordinate with training department; Execute workshops and emails; Evaluate personnel awareness to identify weaknesses. Deliverables: Implementation action plan, shared materials, and list of beneficiaries.

1-10-3-1.title: Awareness: Phishing and Email Security
1-10-3-1.objective: To educate personnel on secure handling of email and social engineering threats.
implementation_guidelines: Provide awareness focusing on safe email handling.
Cover phishing tactics and social engineering techniques.
Document requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Evidence of providing content specifically for phishing and email safety.
1-10-3-1.full_text: 1-10-3-1 Secure handling of email services, especially phishing emails: Guidelines: Provide programs on email/social engineering safety; Document requirements. Deliverables: Approved policy, action plan, and evidence of phishing awareness delivery.

1-10-3-2.title: Awareness: Mobile Devices and Storage Media
1-10-3-2.objective: To ensure safe handling of mobile devices and removable storage media.
implementation_guidelines: Provide awareness content on mobile device security.
Cover the risks associated with storage media (e.g., USBs).
Document requirements and obtain approval.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Evidence of awareness content delivery for mobile and media safety.
1-10-3-2.full_text: 1-10-3-2 Secure handling of mobile devices and storage media: Guidelines: Provide programs on mobile/media safety; Document in requirements. Deliverables: Approved policy, action plan, and evidence of content provision.

1-10-3-3.title: Awareness: Secure Internet Browsing
1-10-3-3.objective: To educate personnel on safe web browsing practices and suspicious link identification.
implementation_guidelines: Cover risks of suspicious websites, phantom phishing sites, and malicious links.
Provide guidance on safe browsing habits.
Document requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Evidence of awareness content provision for secure browsing.
1-10-3-3.full_text: 1-10-3-3 Secure Internet browsing: Guidelines: Cover suspicious sites, phantom phishing, and malicious links; Document requirements. Deliverables: Approved policy, action plan, and evidence of browsing awareness delivery.

1-10-3-4.title: Awareness: Secure Use of Social Media
1-10-3-4.objective: To ensure personnel understand the cybersecurity risks of social media usage.
implementation_guidelines: Provide programs covering safe handling of social media accounts and information sharing.
Document requirements and obtain representative approval.
expected_deliverables: Approved policy or procedure document.
Evidence of social media awareness content provision.
1-10-3-4.full_text: 1-10-3-4 Secure use of social media: Guidelines: Provide programs on safe social media handling; Document in requirements. Deliverables: Approved policy, action plan, and evidence of content provision.

1-10-4-1.title: Training for Cybersecurity Function Personnel
1-10-4-1.objective: To provide specialized training and career paths for dedicated cybersecurity staff.
implementation_guidelines: Develop and implement an approved training plan (internal or industry courses).
Establish career paths for professional progression in cybersecurity fields.
Advocate for adequate funding for training resources and instructors.
expected_deliverables: Approved training plans for the cybersecurity department.
Cybersecurity training certificates.
Documented career paths.
1-10-4-1.full_text: 1-10-4-1 Essential and customized training for Cybersecurity Function: Guidelines: Implement approved training plans; Establish career paths; Advocate for funding (internal/external). Deliverables: Approved plans, and training certificates.

1-10-4-2.title: Training for Developers and IT Operators
1-10-4-2.objective: To provide training in secure coding and safe management of IT assets.
implementation_guidelines: Develop training plans for secure application development and asset management.
Define career paths for software developers and IT operators to allow growth.
Request funding for sector-related courses and trainers.
expected_deliverables: Approved training programs for developers and operators.
Training certificates in secure software/application development.
1-10-4-2.full_text: 1-10-4-2 Training for software/application development and IT assets operations: Guidelines: Plan for secure development and asset management; Define career paths; Request funding for specialized trainers. Deliverables: Approved training programs, and certificates in secure coding.

1-10-4-3.title: Training for Executive and Supervisory Positions
1-10-4-3.objective: To ensure leadership understands cybersecurity risks and strategic threats.
implementation_guidelines: Focus on key risks like 'Whale Phishing' and developing a security culture.
Establish career paths and provide growth opportunities within cybersecurity fields.
Ensure executive support for training resource funding.
expected_deliverables: Security training programs dedicated to executives and supervisors.
Executive training certificates.
1-10-4-3.full_text: 1-10-4-3 Training for Executive and supervisory positions: Guidelines: Conduct awareness on Whale Phishing and culture; Implement training plans; Assist in career path growth; Advocate for funding. Deliverables: Dedicated executive training programs, and certificates.

1-10-5.title: Periodic Review of Awareness Program
1-10-5.objective: To assess and improve the effectiveness of awareness and training programs periodically.
implementation_guidelines: Conduct periodic assessments (e.g., quarterly) of awareness and training plans.
Review implementation through traditional (email) or automated (compliance system) channels.
Develop a compliance assessment schedule.
expected_deliverables: Results of implementation review.
Compliance Assessment Schedule document.
Compliance assessment report for awareness and training.
1-10-5.full_text: 1-10-5 Periodic review of the cybersecurity awareness program: Guidelines: Conduct quarterly assessments; Review via email or automated compliance systems; Develop review plan. Deliverables: Implementation review results, Assessment Schedule, and compliance report.
